content:
maria.gonzalez: FYI @channel customer Acme Health is disputing their June invoice — they were charged $11,430 but their dashboard shows ~$10,200. Ticket CS-7284 opened. can someone triage? :warning:

alex.chu: on it. maria, can you drop the invoice id and the exact line items here?

maria.gonzalez: Invoice INV-2025-06-ACME-9812; line items show "generation-tokens: 9,340,212" and "embed-ingest: 1,012,000". Dashboard (org: acme-health) shows total tokens ~10,200,000. attached screenshots to the ticket.

invoices-bot: Automated alert — Invoice INV-2025-06-ACME-9812 created 2025-06-30 18:02 UTC. Charging multiplier: region-eu x1.00.

sara_finops: pulling ledger + metering events now. quick glance: looks like there are extra ~1.15M tokens charged in the pipeline window 2025-06-29 03:00-03:15 UTC. assigning eng to confirm root cause.

raj.patel: quick query against metering.events: 
```
SELECT count(*) as ev, sum(tokens) as t
FROM metering.events
WHERE org_id='acme-health' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-06-29 03:00' AND '2025-06-29 03:15';
```
result: ev=12, t=514000
those 12 events came from batch-uploader service. I see duplicate event_hash values and identical payloads — looks like retries emitted duplicate events.

alex.chu: our dedupe step depends on request_id. batch-uploader's retry path didn't populate request_id for retried attempts. so duplicates bypassed dedupe and landed in billing.

sara_finops: finance — what remedy do you want? provisional credit while we fix backfill?

kevin_finance: approve provisional credit $1,230 USD pending final revrec adjustment. please create revrec note RN-2025-06-472 and link to INV-2025-06-ACME-9812. finance will finalize after we confirm ledger reconciliation.

maria.gonzalez: emailed Acme Health with provisional credit notice and expected timeline. they're ok to wait for final confirmation.

raj.patel: I'll push a fix to batch-uploader to populate request_id on retries and add server-side dedupe for event_hash. PR: github.com/redwood/batch-uploader/pull/874. also preparing a backfill script to mark duplicates as deduped.

alex.chu: backfill approach (run in maintenance window):
```
UPDATE metering.events e
SET deduped=true
FROM (
  SELECT event_hash, min(id) as keep
  FROM metering.events
  WHERE org_id='acme-health' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-06-29' AND '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY event_hash
  HAVING count(*)>1
) d WHERE e.event_hash=d.event_hash AND e.id!=d.keep;
```
this will zero out duplicate token totals for the org without touching unique events.

sara_finops: ran backfill off-peak; results: tokens reduced from 11,352,212 to 10,207,212 after dedupe. ledger adjusted and automatic invoice patch queued. scheduling refund for the delta.

kevin_finance: confirmed RN-2025-06-472 posted. refund $1,230 scheduled to payment method on file. revenue recognition note: Q2 adjustment, code REV-ADJ-25Q2. I'll attach revrec docs to the jira ticket FIN-9843.

maria.gonzalez: looping back to customer — refund + final note sent, CS ticket CS-7284 -> resolved on our side.

raj.patel: side action: adding extra logging for batch-uploader retries and monitoring alert when there are >5 duplicate events in a 1h window.

alex.chu: thanks team. follow-ups: (1) deploy batch-uploader fix (PR 874) (2) enable retry request_id check (3) confirm invoice patch completed and reconcile with Acme.

sara_finops: all done. invoice updated and GLS ledger reconciled. closing finance side once the posted refund clears.

maria.gonzalez: closing loop — customer confirmed refund receipt later today. great job everyone :tada:
